PullRequest.Title: sessions: make experimental composer options transparent
PullRequest.Body:

## Summary

- removes the background from the expand/collapse options area in the experimental new-session composer
- keeps the options flush with the chat input without adding spacing between the surfaces
- preserves fully rounded corners on both the options tray and chat input
- updates the component fixture geometry and loud-background expectation for the transparent tray

## Testing

- `npm run stylelint -- src/vs/sessions/contrib/chat/browser/media/chatWidget.css` — passed
- `npm run compile` — passed with 0 errors
- Component Explorer experimental composer fixtures — dark, light, loud-background, and collapsed variants rendered stably
- OSS Agents window — verified the running tray rule has no background, zero margin, and the outer radius

Scenarios.Scenario: Render and expand/collapse the options tray in the experimental new-session composer
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The existing composer render creates the fixed, small picker row; the changed CSS computes an intrinsic tray width and the existing 180 ms details transition updates layout/paint before the expanded or collapsed state is visually complete. No subprocess, IPC, filesystem, database, or network work is reached by the changed styling. The fixture geometry reads are test-only.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: A bounded set of visible composer controls (workspace plus repository/worktree, branch, and session-type controls), not workspace history or repository item count. Expansion is one user-triggered transition at a time.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Single browser UI-thread style/layout/paint sequence. The responsive-layout observer watches the unchanged full-width outer container, so the tray's intrinsic width transition does not trigger its clone-and-measure routine on every animation frame; no new task burst or parallel boundary calls are introduced.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No application cache, cache key, miss path, or coalescing behavior changes. Normal browser style caching applies equally before and after the CSS edit.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High confidence that the change adds only bounded intrinsic sizing, border/radius paint, and parent-width layout during the existing transition; surrounding code confirms no changed expensive boundary or repeated responsive measurement path.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Exact per-frame layout and paint time depends on the browser and theme, but the affected DOM is small and bounded; there is no evidence of collection-wide work or an observer feedback loop.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable performance regression. The tray now grows with its revealed controls, but the work is bounded to a few DOM nodes and one short user-triggered transition.

Scenarios.Scenario: Render the experimental composer or quick-chat header over a configured chat background
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Composer construction and the existing reactive layout class toggle are followed by browser style/layout/paint. Removing the tray/header opaque background changes compositing appearance but does not add a renderer, fetch, decode, or other asynchronous dependency to the critical path.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: One composer surface and one small tray/header per visible new-session view; background content size and picker data cardinality are unchanged.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: One foreground UI render; no queue, limiter, IPC, subprocess, or network concurrency is changed.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Background selection/image caching and picker data caching are unchanged; the diff only changes CSS declarations and screenshot expectations.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High confidence from the CSS and renderer call path that this is a bounded paint/compositing change with no newly reached expensive boundary.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: GPU occlusion and paint details vary by platform, but the diff removes an opaque fill rather than introducing filters, backdrop effects, or animated background work, so there is no concrete new scaling mechanism.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable performance regression. Transparency and corner styling alter visual composition only; no concrete CPU, memory, I/O, or rendering-cost amplification is established.

Analysis.Summary: Reviewed the complete three-file diff and traced the production composer render, options-toggle transition, responsive measurement observer, quick-chat header, and chat-background styling. Test changes only update bounded fixture geometry assertions and screenshot metadata. No actionable diff-introduced performance issue or qualifying regression fix was found.
